content:
Actually, 9.9 is greater than 9.11.

When comparing decimal numbers, we compare digit by digit from left to right:
- Both numbers have 9 in the ones place
- In the tenths place (first digit after the decimal): 9.9 has 9, while 9.11 has 1
- Since 9 > 1 in the tenths place, we know that 9.9 > 9.11

It might help to think of these as money: $9.90 is more than $9.11, or to write them with the same number of decimal places: 9.90 vs 9.11.
